name: io.github.PaSympa/discord-mcp
description: Run your Discord from Claude, Codex, Cursor or VS Code: messages, moderation, roles, forums, events
title: discord-mcp

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Discord bot token

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_MCP_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated toolsets to expose: discovery, messages, channels, permissions, members, roles, moderation, screening, stats, forums, webhooks, scheduled_events, invites, dm, or all. An unknown name stops the server at startup.

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to expose only the read-only tools of the selected toolsets: write tools are neither listed nor callable. Any value other than true/false, 1/0, yes/no or on/off stops the server at startup.

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_ALLOWED_GUILDS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated guild IDs the server may act on. Calls that target any other guild are rejected. Unset allows every guild.

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_MESSAGE_CONTENT
environmentVariables.description: Set to false to stop requesting the Message Content privileged intent at connect time.

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_GUILD_MEMBERS
environmentVariables.description: Set to false to stop requesting the Server Members privileged intent at connect time.

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: stdio, or http to serve Streamable HTTP on /mcp for remote clients such as the OpenAI Responses API, Codex or n8n. Any other value stops the server at startup.

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token every HTTP request must carry. Required when DISCORD_MCP_TRANSPORT is http: at least 32 characters from the RFC 6750 b64token alphabet, different from DISCORD_TOKEN. Generate one with openssl rand -hex 32.

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_MCP_HTTP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Address the HTTP server listens on when DISCORD_MCP_TRANSPORT is http. Keep 127.0.0.1 unless the server runs in a container.

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_MCP_HTTP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port the HTTP server listens on when DISCORD_MCP_TRANSPORT is http.

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_MCP_HTTP_ALLOWED_HOSTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated hostnames, without port, accepted in the Host header of HTTP requests besides localhost, 127.0.0.1 and [::1], such as the public name a reverse proxy forwards.
